notes.title: Update V0.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/4e36f63f843ae9f347f3335bec0e814ca7d613c2.png[/img] [h3]After more than a year and a half of dedication and effort, we are excited to present to you the renewed interface.

All the visual elements of the HUD and inventory have been completely redesigned, along with new mechanics, new maps, and a redesigned gameplay for the war mode.[/h3]

[previewyoutube=GPksYfehCVk;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/4e36f63f843ae9f347f3335bec0e814ca7d613c2.png[/img]

[h1]Interface[/h1]

We carried out a complete overhaul of the user interface. We redesigned the HUD, minimap, and inventory to give you a more intuitive and tailored experience, especially focused on crafting and inventory management.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/c3bc99265821376268ea93ebd2ad6d2e30d74635.png[/img] We listened to your feedback and worked hard to create an interface that allows you to access all the tools and resources needed to survive and thrive in World Titans War more efficiently.

[h1]Inventory[/h1] With the new inventory, you will easily access all the components of your equipment. It is divided into two areas: the equipment section, dedicated to managing your clothing and accessories, and the weapons area, where you can manage your tools.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/a3bfbc2fa41cdacdf822dac6aef8e34bff59c74e.png[/img]

In the weapons section, you will be able to view the remaining durability of your weapons, quickly reload magazines, and add attachments. This design provides you with efficient organization and quick access to your survival and combat resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/0295b4fcc1934a84181cd9b7972d092d8986db83.png[/img]

Now you can quickly reload your magazines no matter which pocket your bullets are in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/8a2a62c876f1fe3ffdb10e86eae94b3dc8829a17.gif[/img]

[h1]Crafting[/h1]

In this new menu, you’ll have access to everything you can craft without needing a workbench. With the use of different tools, you can create simple and complex items directly. You just need your hands and some good-quality tools to build what you need to survive. Level up your skills progressively and unlock new recipes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/05ca09aec8a7ded2b63cca59f395c5484bd8d8cd.png[/img]

[h1]Loot and Proximity[/h1]

The proximity menu automatically appears when you detect items on the ground, without needing to crouch to pick them up. This simplifies interaction with other players by making it quick and efficient to gather nearby items. If you run out of inventory space, you can still craft while items are on the ground. You can always use Ctrl+click to quickly move items to your equipment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/4226c8d8a3b1ff7733253a967159d55a2bf847dd.png[/img]

[h1]Notebook[/h1] We’ve introduced a notebook where you’ll find all the essential tools and resources for your survival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/0d6b15d85d210980bec79f8473dd16f70f85a569.jpg[/img] [h3]Page 1 - Strategic Map[/h3] In this first section, your character has access to a detailed strategic map. Here you can interact by marking important zones for your survival strategy. The [b]key innovation[/b] is that the marks you set are shared with your clan or military squad members, promoting collaboration and coordination in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/502bc78d1d3a469f9b1df524a476b80dfbee4010.png[/img]

[h3]Page 2 - Character Skills[/h3] This page offers a [b]complete view[/b] of your character's skills. You can explore existing abilities and discover new ones that can be unlocked as you progress through the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/055e118cbb7947b622a5b4faf59d68b0c3a71ee7.png[/img]

[h3]Page 3 - Clan Group[/h3] In the group section, you’ll find detailed information about each member of your clan and shared notes on the right side of the page.

[h3]Page 4 - Missions[/h3] When you activate a mission, all relevant information is organized on this page. From objectives to [b]rewards[/b], this section keeps everything related to missions clear and accessible, making it easier to manage and track your goals in the game.

[h3]Page 5 - Server Ranking[/h3] In the server ranking, you can view [b]your stats[/b] and the ranking of players on the server based on survival points. This friendly competition adds an extra layer of excitement to the game, encouraging you to improve and stand out in the overall ranking.

[b]Survival points (SP) will help you respawn.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/1ab46d4efc4438de19fb8dbfc79c929517a5022b.png[/img]

[h3]Page 6 - Daily and Weekly Tasks[/h3] Daily and weekly tasks are organized in this section, offering [b]rewards[/b] for your continuous progress. You can track your progress and work towards specific goals that enhance your experience and unlock valuable rewards.

[h3]Page 7 - Military Report[/h3] In the military report, you can [b]enlist for war[/b] and check [b]your reputation[/b] on the battlefield. This section provides a comprehensive summary of your participation in war events, allowing you to evaluate and improve your impact on the global conflict in the game.

[h1]Military Map Icons[/h1]

Improvements to the military map now allow you to [b]see in real-time[/b] the exact location of all squads, marking attack points for effective tactical coordination. Additionally, the ability to identify and mark enemy mines on the map adds an extra layer of security and planning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/7244a5f9a1db1f19d395251e2c3dcc76f73cc37d.png[/img]

The visual differentiation of squads through colors (green for your squad and blue for other allied squads) simplifies identifying teammates, showing their names, and promoting more efficient collaboration.

The commander’s permanent guide provides real-time instructions and strategies, improving decision-making and overall coordination.

[h1]Bulletproof Vests[/h1]

We have added bulletproof vests to the list of available equipment in the game!

Now, players will have the option to equip themselves with these highly protective vests, offering an additional layer of defense against enemy fire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/3893c6f1715f6b73f689795f2df9f622b5847376.jpg[/img] With this new addition, we hope that players can face the new challenges of the game with greater security.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/51929eee76cf485b6680b019526211d3aac3f405.jpg[/img] Additionally, as a survivor, you will need to work on your engineering skills to be able to craft your own bulletproof vest from the crafting menu.

[h1]New Clothing[/h1]

Particularly relevant to the survival world, we’ve added extra jackets, shirts, and undershirts. Now, you have the ability to tear any type of clothing to obtain rags, essential items for crafting your mattress, which serves as a temporary respawn point.

Remember to always keep a knife or another sharp tool with you to make your rags whenever you need them.

[h1]American Vehicle Willys MB[/h1]

[h3]The Willys MB is a 4x4 utility vehicle manufactured by Willys-Overland during World War II, known as the Jeep.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/4ed6549ac356ea43f9e304dd6c6c226a9e52656c.png[/img]

[h3]It was designed to be rugged, capable of traversing difficult terrains, and transporting soldiers and equipment over long distances.[/h3]

[h3]It featured a more robust suspension and increased ground clearance to enhance its off-road capabilities.[/h3]

[h3]Its compact size and 4x4 traction made it a reliable and capable vehicle in a wide range of terrains.[/h3]

[h3]Now food expires, you will have to cook and manage your rations. Some expired product can cause your death.[/h3]

[h3]- Increased supplies at military base[/h3]
We have reinforced military construction, material and fuel resources at military bases.

[h3]
- As a military, you will be able to loot in the cities[/h3]
Now during your military gameplay you will be able to find all kinds of resources needed for constructions in cities and loot areas. 

[h3] Conquest AI[/h3]
Now the war not only depends on our strategy, the AI during the players' rest can conquer flags. The war will be in continuous movement. It will be an essential support for your single player games. 

[list]
    [*]Attacking AI is based on a squad of soldiers that will attack any enemy, its mission: to enter the enemy flag and fight until death or conquest. 
    [*]Defender AI will protect the flag from any enemy that is able to enter.
[/list]

notes.title: Update WTW v02.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/686e0a9531958e007138840cceb43c21376c2b34.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/71eeaf6fc7897ffdd45283710b55c280f093545b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/9231af6512e2f65dd852f99d2cc0546cd5a4cdc4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/b6f586aa91955cffb55f089f84437123b756b292.png[/img]

[h3] We're incorporate military missions, the war isn't only fight, kill enemies and conquest flags, you will need make a good logistic strategy to supply your army and avoid enemy advance. Below we show you the different types of missions included in this update.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/1734bd60ae1161930d901c30cc5fd8a0e82d9fd7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/ff961d58bc8aaf16b75ecc5506971b42162e34e0.png[/img]

[h3]You can fortify each flag under your control, with this you will avoid the enemy advance and will help your allies to defend the zone.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/5646175948ae473a75085ce01d80a6de5e9bbd2e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/c560ab3971803f6fff2954bddddbb767b9dbbfcf.png[/img]

[h3]When all flags of the sector will stay under your army control, you will can configure the antenna to detec enemy camp builded in this sector to can destroy and thereby cause chaos in the enemy ranks.
But be careful, if the enemy manages to conquer an area of the sector, he will be able to neutralize your antenna. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/d4702d0d173ed8e7f2d03df282278d21fbbd3e47.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/c717366d2c7fd07f29aa039fa45c4cbda8385456.png[/img]

[h3]Your allies try to control the roads and paths of the sector, but help will always come in handy, help them by building roadblocks that will prevent the rapid advance of the enemy.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/6ff5f6703b59d7266d2830caa89eca2b776b130a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/9b88a8138dc1593189b2c2ac9a5d00b456a4795b.png[/img]

[h3]The construction of camps, composed of; Communication center, armory, workshop and barracks, are essential to make your army defend and attack. Choose wisely where you build them, as a well hidden camp between the battle lines can be the difference between victory or defeat. Keep in mind that if the enemy finds and destroys your communications center, the rest of the camp will be destroyed.[/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/67943e2add221e5f824005e21dca8cb3b1039bf5.png[/img]

[h3]Select this mission to take your squad to the front, fight and conquer the enemy flags.[/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/e7dcd999a7d777a8266b6be6c02c735b13d998ac.png[/img]

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
[h1]GREETINGS TITANS[/h1]

[h3]The first thing is to thank you for all the support and love that we are receiving and that helps us to keep working to bring news and that you continue enjoying World Titans War.[/h3]
That said, we are going to tell you what we are working on and what will come sooner rather than later.
[h3]THANKS YOU![/h3]

[hr]----------------------------------------[/hr]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1691480/
[hr]----------------------------------------[/hr]

[h2]WAR MODE REWORK[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/88a72060c0e10b8adc98db16a9ab1bb4f48916eb.gif[/img]

[code]We are adding military missions, each squad leader will have to communicate to his headquarters which mission his squad is going to carry out, choosing a mission from the list of available missions. War is no longer just about conquering, but also about communication, organization and logistics.[/code]

[h3]Each type of mission is described in detail below[/h3]
https://youtu.be/iNAW4WRRIxI

[h2]Building camps[/h2]

[h3]First step to make your army have respawn in each sector, store ammunition and resources to be used later, spawn vehicles on the battlefield, both trucks and tanks or for the commander to launch bombardments on the enemy lines.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/e4c5c037cce3dc36caf49d20600346ea6d70dd04.gif[/img]
[code] Armory: Stores ammunition, resupplies the army, etc. [/code]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/08f12d305dde1f5a3845f6882655a09bf8ee6c99.gif[/img]
[code] Military Workshop, as long as you have enough fuel stored, will allow you to spawn vehicles on the battlefield, both trucks and tanks.  [/code]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/80eac6b828d19c764cb357d6532b6e858494f586.gif[/img]
[code] Communication center, it is the center of the military camps, from which you can build the rest of the constructions, in addition, it will allow the commander to launch bombardments on the enemy lines. [/code]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/6b31aab4ea4eb2b59085979c6110258d821869a4.gif[/img]
[code] Barracks, allows the respawn of all the soldiers of the army, in addition, you will have access to your personal chest, where you can see your belongings and rewards. [/code]


[h2]Create fortifications[/h2]

[h3]Once the area is conquered by your army, the squad that chooses the mission will be able to build fortifications to prevent the enemy from advancing.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/b5d3c965a6f88420dd63e5d75bdfacd94b4b33e9.gif[/img]
[code] Fortify the flags that are under the control of your army, completing the fortification missions. [/code]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/e1bb3e91b17e54b0e50bd790d8e2cb94b4f1af56.gif[/img]
[code] Collaborate with your squad to fortify areas faster. [/code]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/4d10f62274ac3570ee24a03ff17a02fa0f1751f0.gif[/img]
[code] You can also fortify areas by deciding where to build some of the available fortifications, such as sandbags. [/code]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/880d0afb21365f5640746a12f1989766c0781684.gif[/img]
[code] Build the bunkers required by the fortification mission to help you and your army to defend the area by shooting at your enemies. [/code]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/0eabb3cd7cb28f80db66625c13302c61382f66e8.gif[/img]
[code] By completing fortification missions you will be able to access areas where you couldn't before. [/code]


[h2]Antenna configuration[/h2]

[h3]When the entire sector is conquered by your army, you will be able to set up the radio antenna that will allow you to find enemy camps within the sector.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/893069ca929fe81a52afeb5af16749f21fa1a028.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/749423de90151c00e2b5316d49f9eb39338a5663.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/94e83a63fa01c69a8a5152e449040e45583b6483.gif[/img]
[code] Soldier setting up an antenna and helping his army locate enemy camps. [/code]


[h2]Conquest of flags[/h2]

[h3]Conquering flags is still essential to win the war, but now you will have to select the mission to get your reward.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/3b61482f1a4546a878f6ccf6facbb032afee54e8.gif[/img]



[h2]Constructing roadblocks[/h2]

[h3]As your army advances through the terrain, road control missions will be activated, building it will allow your NPC allies to have a better control of the area forcing the enemy to fight and open the barrier or destroy it.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/8d71d45045008c16ac166421209c74430c13e87e.gif[/img]
[code] Help your NPC allies defend the roads, and completing roadblock missions will slow down the enemy. [/code]

[h2][h1]RANGES[/h1][/h2]

[h3]We are implementing the ranks in the army, each army will have 15 different ranks, you will be able to ascend in rank by completing the different missions, eliminating the enemy soldiers and winning the war.

With each promotion, your military salary will increase, even depending on your rank you can unlock different weapons in some roles.

Will you achieve the rank of Generalfeldmarschall in the German army or the rank of General in the American army?[/h3]

[hr][/hr]

[h1]COMING SOON[/h1]

[h2]Map rework[/h2]

[h3]As we mentioned in previous communications, the map design work is still being done, we are improving the map in all aspects, new towns, cities and farms as well as repainting the terrain with new material.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/e65359f5d96a9ea74f747fdf817da3f226ec6c9d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/4242dff1fb2277af94e626cd98c6e4e40ecab27c.jpg[/img]

Soon, we will incorporate the rework in the B5 sector, including new areas where you can loot, trade and help civilian NPCs, of course the military will also be present in this new area:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/b4adc02ab7e0042fb6d07379ce6331bdac68a893.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/03ee24f09d65b92f64eb89dfbb5696b8944d005d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Vehicles rework[/h2]

[h3]Although in the last update, the physics and general handling of the vehicles were improved, we are still working on them, further improving them to offer you a good experience.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/7c83f8e594885b542097ee662380432dbb805f27.gif[/img]

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]GREETINGS, TITANS![/b][/h1]

First of all, we would like to thank to the entire World Titans World community for your collaboration in this exciting project, as you know, any suggestion are welcome and analyzed by the developer’s team.

[h3]Because our history would not be possible without you, [b]THANK YOU[/b].[/h3]

We want to take the opportunity to show you everything that will come in a close future. After adding more than 300 missions and seeing the great reception they have had among the players, we have decided to incorporate three new modes: construction, destruction and siege. Those ones will include a new merchant’s mechanic, increase gameplay and immersion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/1fcd6a3815aa69cb3550b6c15e047a8d7edf1860.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Siege Missions[/b][/h1]

You will be sent to a random point on the map, where an enemy will try to spread panic. It will be in your hands to recover the peace. At first, it will seem easy, but they won’t give up without fight and the difficulty will increase.  [b]Can you against everyone?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/f35e2c58013720bfe04e1d5bb9de21aafd2bc328.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Construction and destruction missions[/b][/h1]

Those two go hand by hand and now you will know why. You will receive instructions on where and what to build, but not the materials. Easy? Go for it. Once you finish the construction, another clan will receive orders to destroy it, or perhaps, your own clan.
Poor merchant…  [i]oops, I missed it[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/974f303a698bf02c296caa6cccc27ae20bdb6c30.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/1cc539c2ef9a9cc41c6bf30c09f9f6ca14e2aee8.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Vehicles[/b][/h1]

Although the vehicles have improved a lot, we as players demand even more of ourselves, that's why we are going to implement new mechanics, which apart from improving performance on the servers, will give better playability.

One of the suggestions of a titan named [b]Sergio_M (᚛Θω☢᚜)[/b] was to include two-wheelers vehicles. We want to tell you that we already have them designed, but yes, it will take more time for us to integrate them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/0d5fa98bc8153a10f203ba0c150098959b02603a.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Do you want to discover new settlements?[/b][/h1]

We know that you want diversity in landscapes and different areas to explore, so here we leave to all of you some new locations and terrain images you haven't seen yet. Remember, this will be incorporated step by step in future updates, we will inform you of our progress. We can only say that it is already being tested on our private testing servers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/c1a585171914aee8e89b1cdac06e5dd74830dd3e.jpg[/img]

Although already snows in the world of WTW, we are creating a new biome of mountainous areas, where the temperature will make much more sense, the need of using warm clothes... A different combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/69604168cebca3fd454f6f448f30706fd925d184.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/bdf1fcbb4a015a2d3bbf709aecb61adf65477ef3.jpg[/img]

The trenches were deep, but how about a hard-to-reach and well-protected Bunker?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/f131970e89422097cfba075939d6c1fd87a63dfa.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/28775491356fcba6ab1ab77581ce226af041dd61.jpg[/img]

Our goal is to introduce more armies and cities that can take you to the Europe of 1939 – 1945. Here is a small sample. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/a6824f5fbf788b33c873e65da1198d3d6abeb52b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/785c715322dbba3650a9c9ccffff156fd2df1ae8.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Vive la France![/b][/h3]

notes.content:

Today we bring you a new update, then we detail the new things that you can find in WTW.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/aa748110459211a28ea1b4984b5dcf15884a2932.png[/img]

The military will thank you! From this moment you can launch a plane from the military base with the supplies that the team needs, advance through the air and avoid the enemy tanks, drop the supplies in the rear and take the opportunity to crush them.

Among all the suggestions for DROPS that we received from the players, we liked one of the proposals and we have carried it out.

It's about plane crashes, every once in a while a plane will start to fly around the map, at one point in its journey it will break down and end up in a tragic accident. The survivors will be able to go to the area and loot the resources that the plane was carrying. But beware! Fire and gasoline are not good friends so there will come a time when the plane will explode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/114515c62645fc862e47efd13886a28a161682de.jpg[/img]

These same locks can be used to close the houses that are already in the world of WTW. Attention! Due to this change the doors of the houses can be destroyed with explosives.

In total there are 4 types of padlocks, metal, copper, gold and platinum.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41291626/0c3af094629968dbfa7794130dfcba7966caa38f.png[/img]
